:::{#exm-cond-variance}
#### Conditional variance of a binary outcome

Let $(X, Y)$ have the [joint PMF](random-variables.qmd#def-joint-pmf)
$\P(X=0, Y=0) = 0.2$, $\P(X=0, Y=1) = 0.3$,
$\P(X=1, Y=0) = 0.1$, $\P(X=1, Y=1) = 0.4$
(the table in the [expectation page's exercise](expectation.qmd#exr-fubini-joint-disc)).
Given $X = 0$, $Y$ is binary with

$$
\begin{aligned}
\P(Y = 1 \mid X = 0) &= 0.3/0.5 \\
&= 0.6,
\end{aligned}
$$

so $\E{Y \mid X = 0} = 0.6$, and by @def-cond-variance:

$$
\ba
\Var{Y \mid X = 0}
&= (0 - 0.6)^2 \cd 0.4 + (1 - 0.6)^2 \cd 0.6
&& \text{(definition of conditional variance)} \\
&= 0.144 + 0.096
&& \text{(multiply)} \\
&= 0.24
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$

The same steps with

$$
\begin{aligned}
\P(Y = 1 \mid X = 1) &= 0.4/0.5 \\
&= 0.8
\end{aligned}
$$

give

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Var{Y \mid X = 1} &= (0.2)^2 \cd 0.8 + (0.8)^2 \cd 0.2 \\
&= 0.16.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
